_note: The Lead Agent only calls agents from this list. A call to an unlisted agent falls to user approval in the Policy Gate. '@key' in 'writes' is a folder in governance/paths.json. No count limit; several copies of one agent may run in parallel. 'tools' must match the agent definition's frontmatter (.claude/agents/<name>.md) exactly; tests/test_governance.py checks the drift. 'shell' is required when Bash is in tools: 'limited' means policy.json -> agent_shell lists the allowed commands, 'broad' means the agent runs any non-denied command and the Policy Gate is its only limit. 'builtin' agents come from Claude Code and have no definition file.

head.name: lead-agent
head.role: Main session. Splits the task, dispatches to specialists, routes help requests, has results checked by the reviewer and presents them to the user.

agents.name: skill-scout
agents.role: Capability Scout — task → skill/agent/tool matching, skill gap detection

agents.name: incident-responder
agents.role: Incident Response Analyst — host evidence, read-only, Bash limited to hash/count (stage 2, agent_shell)

agents.name: deliverable-writer
agents.role: Customer Deliverable Writer — approved report → customer document in the customer's language
